...COLD WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 3 AM TO 9 AM EST FRIDAY...
* WHAT...Very cold wind chills as low as 30 expected.
* WHERE...Inland Broward County, Inland Miami-Dade County, Inland Palm Beach County, Glades, Hendry, and Inland Collier County Counties.
* WHEN...From 3 AM to 9 AM EST Friday.
* IMPACTS...Very cold temperatures can lead to hypothermia with prolonged exposure.
PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...
Use caution while traveling outside. Wear appropriate clothing, a hat, and gloves.
Keep pets indoors as much as possible.
Make sure outdoor animals have a warm, dry shelter, food, and unfrozen water.
Make frequent checks on older family, friends, and neighbors. Ensure portable heaters are used correctly. Do not use generators or grills inside.
If you do not have heat in your home or lack shelter, you can call 211.
